fr-E6-19609.title: 정치군사국; 무기수출통제법 및 국제무기거래규정에 따른 법정 거래금지 조치
fr-E6-19609.orig: Bureau of Political-Military Affairs; Statutory Debarment Under the Arms Export Control Act and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations
fr-E6-19609.quote: "Notice is hereby given that persons convicted of violating or conspiring to violate Section 38 of the Arms Export Control Act, as amended, ("AECA") (22 U.S.C. 2778) are statutorily debarred pursuant to Section 38(g)(4) of the AECA and Section 127.7(c) of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations ("ITAR") (22 CFR parts 120 to 130)."

fr-E6-19609.meta: Federal Register 공고, 2006. 11. 20. 게재. State Department
